context: Two teens dissect a viral school rumor
purpose: Teach: 抱か/疑っ/なにやら/至ら/気がつく/引き出す/種々/大人気

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、最近大人気のあの噂、聞いた？三組の先輩が転校するって話。
lines.en: Hey, did you hear that super hot rumor going around lately? The one about a senior from class three transferring.
lines.style: Excited teen girl leaning in with conspiratorial energy and rising intonation

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あー、それね。俺、最初から疑ってたんだよ。なにやら出どころが怪しすぎてさ。
lines.en: Oh, that one. I doubted it from the very start. Something about the source feels way too sketchy.
lines.style: Skeptical teen boy speaking with relaxed but firm dismissive tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でもみんな信じちゃってるし、不安を抱かないでいるのって難しくない？
lines.en: But everyone's just believing it, isn't it hard not to feel anxious about it?
lines.style: Teen girl protesting with slightly whiny anxious lilt and pout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 種々雑多な憶測が飛び交ってるけどさ、誰も本人に確認してないんだぜ？
lines.en: All kinds of random speculation is flying around, but nobody's actually confirmed with the person, right?
lines.style: Teen boy speaking flatly with arms-crossed exasperated logic

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ……あ、こういう時こそ気がつくものだね。最初に流したの、たぶん隣のクラスの子だ。
lines.en: ...Oh, it's at moments like this you really notice. The one who first spread it was probably the girl from the next class.
lines.style: Teen girl pausing mid-thought then speaking with dawning realization

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ほら見ろよ。ちょっと話を引き出すだけで、すぐボロが出るんだって。
lines.en: See what I mean. You just have to draw the story out a little and the cracks show up right away.
lines.style: Teen boy speaking with smug vindicated satisfaction and a grin

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私、考えが至らなかったかも。広める前に気づけてよかったぁ。
lines.en: I guess I wasn't thinking it through. I'm so glad I noticed before spreading it.
lines.style: Teen girl speaking softly with reflective slightly guilty tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: だろ？噂は信じる前に一回疑うのが基本。お前も覚えとけよ。
lines.en: Right? With rumors, doubting once before believing is the basic rule. You remember that too.
lines.style: Teen boy delivering casual lecturing advice with friendly teasing edge
